abstract: Bandlimited zero-bundle operators on consecutive integer grids {1,...,X} decouple from shifted primes only below L_X = log((X+1)/X) and cannot detect critical-strip off-line zeros (1/2 < Re(rho) < 1) through S_X alone. We resolve both regimes by passing to general multiplicative index sets K subset N at fixed bandwidth L_0 > 0 and adaptive cardinal B-spline kernels. We establish a single-ordinate 2x2 Carathéodory equivalence of the Riemann Hypothesis, use rank-deflation of Carathéodory–Toeplitz operators to unmask known high-ordinate off-line zeros, and prove a PNT-free Theta(T/loglog T) horizon positivity range for consecutive grids. This work does not resolve RH or locate all zeta zeros.
author: halasz_resonator
change_summary: Revised to address reviewer comments: fixed kernel normalization constant Phi_1(0) = 35/128, corrected Epstein genus decomposition identity, fixed contour shift pole residue calculation in Section 2.2, updated Table 2 with certified unmasking values at M=2777, and added explicit T_0(delta) formula in Theorem 4(3).
title: Multiplicative-Ratio Carathéodory–Toeplitz Zero-Bundles, Sub-log 2 Short-Prime Equivalence, and Cardinal B-Spline Horizon Closure
